name: Der nächste Besuch
pain: After the first sale nothing gives the customer a concrete reason to come back.
outcome: Every visit ends with a visible reason to return: the card and the next reward.
hook: „Deine Kunden waren schon da. Gib ihnen einen Grund, wiederzukommen.“
channel: Walk-in opener, homepage hero, static ad
proof: Customer card right after the first confirmed visit (1/10, next reward shown)
qualifier: Gives a reason to return; never promises more visits or revenue.

name: Sichtbarer Fortschritt
pain: Paper progress is invisible until the card turns up; customers forget how close they are.
outcome: The customer sees 8/10 on the phone, so the next visit is concrete.
hook: „9 von 10 fühlt sich anders an als 1 von 10.“
qualifier: Describe the mechanism, not a behaviour effect.

name: Papierkarte ablösen
pain: Paper cards get lost, get self-stamped and tell the owner nothing.
outcome: Same ritual on the phone: only staff can stamp, and the owner sees activity.
hook: „Eine Papierkarte zählt Stempel. Mehr weiß sie nicht.“
verticals: Every shop with paper cards (barber, pizzeria, café)
channel: Walk-in when a paper card is on the counter; Reel

name: Keine App
pain: Customers will not install an app for one shop.
outcome: Camera on the code; the card opens in the browser.
hook: „Keine App. Kamera auf den Code. Fertig.“
channel: Walk-in hand-the-phone moment, TikTok, static, retargeting
proof: Owner scans the demo QR (production demo merchant only after D-3; until then the founder tablet with local demo data)
qualifier: QR is the live entry. NFC only as prepared outlook until CORE-11 passes its gate.

name: Ein Ablauf im Stress
pain: If staff cannot use it in a rush, it fails.
outcome: Customer shows the card, staff scans and confirms: one step, several stamps at once if needed.
hook: „Kunde zeigt. Team bestätigt. Fertig.“
channel: Walk-in with staff present, demo, objection ad
proof: Staff confirm screen; several stamps in one step
qualifier: No timing in seconds until measured at pilots. Card-number fallback when the camera fails is RC READY (OPS-03).

name: Team bestätigt jeden Stempel
pain: Self-stamping, friends and screenshots.
outcome: A visit counts only after a staff member confirms it, exactly once.
hook: „Ein Stempel zählt erst, wenn dein Team ihn bestätigt.“
proof: Confirm flow; a screenshot of a card earns nothing
qualifier: Per-card booking history in the owner UI arrives with the RC (TRU-02).

name: Empfehlung zählt beim echten Besuch
pain: Loyalty only retains; word of mouth goes unrewarded and unseen.
outcome: A regular shares a link; the bonus comes only after the newcomer's first staff-confirmed visit.
hook: „Dein bester Kunde kennt vielleicht deinen nächsten.“
proof: Referral pair: shared → card created → first visit confirmed → bonus
qualifier: No monthly cap exists; the same verified email is held for review; bonus frozen at signup; no causation claims.

name: Sehen, ob es genutzt wird
pain: The owner knows faces but not the pattern, and cannot tell whether the programme works.
outcome: The analytics show new cards, confirmed visits, returning cards (two or more visits) and rewards; each card shows its balance and last visit.
hook: „Wer kommt wirklich wieder? Nicht raten – bestätigte Besuche sehen.“
channel: Demo owner view, day-21 review, carousel
proof: Auswertung: Neue Karten · Bestätigte Kassenvorgänge · Wiederkehrende Karten · Prämien
qualifier: Cards are pseudonymous: no names, no contact data. Counts only confirmed loyalty activity, not revenue. Days are UTC-based.

name: 39 € mit deinen eigenen Zahlen
pain: "Noch ein Abo."
outcome: The merchant puts in their own basket and sees how many extra visits cover €39.
hook: „39 € im Monat. Bei dir sind das [n] Besuche.“
qualifier: Rechenbeispiel, keine Prognose. Never „garantiert“.

name: Mit dir eingerichtet
pain: No time for setup, and fear of being left alone with software.
outcome: The founder sets up the programme, sign and staff on site; first real scan the same day where possible.
hook: „Ich richte es mit dir ein – am Tresen, nicht per Ticket.“
qualifier: Staff accounts are operator-provisioned until invite signup (RC) is deployed. Never promise minutes.

name: Antippen statt scannen (NFC)
pain: Even a QR scan is one step too many at a busy counter.
outcome: The customer taps the phone on the counter tag and the card opens; QR stays the fallback.
hook: „Antippen per NFC ist vorbereitet – heute startest du mit dem QR-Code.“
verticals: All; café and bakery benefit most
channel: Today: FAQ and walk-in outlook line only. After the gate: hero, video, walk-in
proof: After the gate: a physical tag tap on a real phone
qualifier: PREVIEW until the RC is deployed AND physical tag acceptance passes. Then it becomes the primary entry claim: „Antippen. Öffnen. Sammeln.“ with QR as fallback (15-copy-switches.md).

name: Ruhende Karten bemerken
pain: A regular disappearing goes unnoticed.
outcome: Each card shows its last confirmed visit, so a dormant card is visible when you look.
hook: „Ein Stammkunde kommt plötzlich nicht mehr. Würdest du es merken?“
channel: Content series „Was würdest du tun?“, demo
qualifier: Today per card and pseudonymous. A list of dormant regulars exists in code but is withheld in production (FUT-01). Never say you see „wer“ is missing.

name: Stempel oder Punkte
pain: Not every business fits „buy ten, get one“.
outcome: Stamps or points, chosen per programme.
hook: „Kauf zehn, bekomm eins – ohne Papier. Oder Punkte, wenn das besser passt.“
qualifier: One programme per location in the pilot.

name: Gehört deinem Laden, nicht einer Plattform
pain: Platforms own the customer relationship.
outcome: The card runs under the shop's name, and the data can be exported.
hook: „Deine Stammkunden gehören dir – nicht einer Plattform.“
proof: Card with the shop name; owner export
qualifier: The export is JSON. No marketing contact data is collected in production.

name: Erst die Kunden, die du schon hast
pain: Paying to find strangers while existing customers drift away.
outcome: Start with the people who already bought.
hook: „Die schwerste Arbeit hast du schon gemacht: Sie waren bei dir.“
qualifier: Framing only; no claim about saved ad costs.

name: Ein Besuch mehr, aufs Jahr gerechnet
pain: One extra visit looks small.
outcome: The calculator shows a repeated extra visit over twelve months.
hook: „Ein zusätzlicher Besuch ist wenig. Jeden Monat einer ist etwas.“
qualifier: Rechenbeispiel based on the merchant's own assumption.

name: Ein Preis pro Standort
pain: Tiered pricing by cards or staff is confusing.
outcome: €39 per location, without counting cards or staff.
hook: „Ein Preis pro Laden. Egal, wie viele Stühle.“
verticals: Barber with several chairs, busy café
qualifier: Contract term, VAT presentation and billing start are owner commercial gates (D-1, O-012).

name: Was kostet Nichtstun?
pain: Lost repeat business is invisible.
outcome: The merchant estimates their own lost regulars.
hook: „Wie viele Stammkunden hast du letztes Jahr verloren, ohne es zu merken?“
qualifier: Ask, don't quantify. No industry statistics.

name: Gründungspartner / früher Pilot
pain: Early merchants want a say.
outcome: Early merchants shape the product.
hook: „Mach früh mit und gestalte Loynara mit.“
qualifier: Only if genuinely offered. Depends on the D-1 commercial terms; not used until the owner approves them.

name: Mundpropaganda bekommt ein System
pain: Word of mouth already happens but goes unseen and unthanked.
outcome: Regulars share a personal link, and the referral is booked fairly.
hook: „Barber leben von Mundpropaganda. Jetzt zählt sie.“
proof: Referral link on the customer card
qualifier: Same rules as CORE-07.

name: Welche Empfehlung wurde ein Besuch?
pain: Nobody can tell which recommendations became real customers.
outcome: Each card shows its referral status (waiting / bonus credited / in review) and how many it referred successfully.
hook: „Ein geteilter Link ist kein Kunde. Ein bestätigter Besuch schon.“
proof: Card detail: Als geworbene Karte · Erfolgreich geworben
qualifier: Per card and pseudonymous; no aggregate referral report is claimed.

name: Starke Empfehler erkennen
pain: The best ambassadors are invisible.
outcome: Cards with several qualified referrals stand out in their detail view.
hook: „Manche Kunden bringen immer wieder jemanden mit.“
qualifier: Pseudonymous and per card; there is no ranking view.

name: Händler empfehlen Händler
pain: Cold doors are slow; owners trust peers.
outcome: Each live merchant introduces one or two other owners.
hook: „Das läuft bei [Laden] – soll er dir zeigen, wie?“
qualifier: No cash reward without D-2. Introductions only with permission (10-merchant-referrals.md).

name: Nicht der Laden nebenan
pain: The shop next door competes for the same regulars.
outcome: Your regulars have a running card with you.
hook: „Gib deinen Stammkunden noch einen Grund, zu dir zu kommen – und nicht nebenan.“
qualifier: No competitor names.

name: Nichts wird doppelt gebucht
pain: A retry or double tap creates double stamps.
outcome: Each confirmation is booked exactly once.
hook: „Zweimal getippt? Trotzdem nur ein Stempel.“

name: Jede Buchung nachvollziehbar
pain: The owner cannot see which staff action changed a balance.
outcome: The card history shows source and reason for every booking and correction.
hook: „Jede Buchung hat einen Ursprung und einen Grund.“
qualifier: Live today: team access history (Zugriffsverlauf) and the owner export. Per-card booking history in the UI arrives with the RC.

name: Daten exportieren
pain: Fear that the data is trapped.
outcome: The owner can export at any time.
hook: „Deine Daten bleiben nicht eingesperrt.“
qualifier: JSON export, not CSV or Excel.

name: Ehrliche Zahlen
pain: Tools take credit for everything.
outcome: Definitions are shown; only confirmed activity counts; no causation claims.
hook: „Gezählt wird nur, was dein Team bestätigt hat.“

name: Was es noch nicht kann
pain: Sales pitches hide the gaps.
outcome: The Ausblick list is said out loud.
hook: „Ich zeig dir auch, was es noch nicht kann.“

name: Kein Spam an deine Kunden
pain: „Ich will meine Kunden nicht zuspammen.“
outcome: Today Loynara sends nothing. Sending, once enabled, checks consent, frequency and quiet hours.
hook: „Loynara verschickt heute nichts an deine Kunden. Und später nur mit Einwilligung und Grenzen.“
qualifier: Messaging is FUTURE; the quiet-hours policy is RC READY. Never present the safeguards as an active feature.

name: Gründer vor Ort
pain: Fear of being left alone with a dashboard.
outcome: The founder comes in person, gives a phone number and follows the day-3/7/21 rhythm.
hook: „Kein Callcenter. Wenn's hakt, ruf mich an.“
qualifier: Say "local" only if it is true.

name: Deine Marke vorne
pain: Generic loyalty looks cheap.
outcome: The card uses the shop's name and colour, and the printed sign matches.
hook: „Deine Marke. Vom Tresen bis zur Kundenkarte.“
qualifier: Logo on the card, Wallet card and premium stand are FUTURE (FUT-14, FUT-15, FUT-16).

name: Pseudonyme Kundenkarten
pain: „Datenschutz?“
outcome: The owner list is pseudonymous, with no names or phone numbers.
hook: „Pseudonyme Karten, keine Telefonnummern.“
qualifier: Do not name a hosting region or certification until the data-protection documents (O-013) are final.

name: Hinweise nach festen Regeln, keine Fake-KI
pain: Dashboards are noise; AI claims are hype.
outcome: The owner gets rule-based hints, each with its reason.
hook: „Hinweise nach festen Regeln – mit Begründung, ohne KI-Versprechen.“
qualifier: Hints only; acting on them (campaigns) is FUTURE (FUT-12). Never call it KI.

name: Gebaut für die echte Schicht
pain: Demos look fine; real shifts break things.
outcome: Live: staff confirmation, offline queue, roles, no double booking. With the RC: corrections, card number, reissue.
hook: „Was passiert, wenn etwas schiefgeht?“
channel: Demo and sales follow-up, not broad ads
qualifier: RC parts are said as „mit dem nächsten Update“ until deployed.

name: Fehler korrigieren, Verlauf bleibt
pain: A wrong stamp cannot be undone cleanly.
outcome: An owner or manager corrects a booking with a reason; the original stays visible as a compensating entry.
hook: „Falscher Stempel? Korrigieren, ohne die Geschichte umzuschreiben.“
qualifier: Live today: no correction button for merchants. Say „kommt mit dem nächsten Update“.

name: Kamera streikt? Kartennummer
pain: When scanning fails, the counter stalls.
outcome: Staff find a card by its short random number (K-XXXXXX).
hook: „Scan klappt nicht? Kartennummer eintippen.“
qualifier: Live today: the owner list can search by the first characters of the internal card ID only.

name: Karte verloren: neu ausstellen, Stand bleibt
pain: A lost phone or link means lost progress.
outcome: An owner or manager reissues the card: same membership, balance, history and card number; the old link and QR stop working.
hook: „Handy weg? Neue Karte, gleicher Stand.“
objection: „Was, wenn ein Kunde sein Handy verliert?“
qualifier: Live today: the customer starts a new card and the merchant re-books known stamps as normal bookings (pilot-recovery-runbook §A). Copy switch: 15-copy-switches.md.

name: Eigene Zugänge und Rollen
pain: Staff share the owner password.
outcome: Each staff member has their own access, in a cashier or management role, and access can be revoked.
hook: „Dein Team arbeitet mit eigenen Zugängen – nicht mit deinem Passwort.“
qualifier: Self-signup through the invite link is RC READY; until then the operator provisions staff accounts.

name: Mehrere Standorte
pain: Several shops, several systems.
outcome: One account, several locations, each priced separately; lists filter by location.
hook: „Ein Konto, mehrere Läden.“
verticals: Owners with two or more shops
proof: Location switch in the owner view
qualifier: Location comparison is FUTURE (FUT-20). Verify per-location staff scoping before claiming it.

name: Netz weg? Stempel kommen nach
pain: Wi-Fi drops at the counter.
outcome: Stamps are queued offline and booked later.
hook: „WLAN weg? Stempel kommen trotzdem an.“
qualifier: Rewards are redeemed online only.

name: Startklar-Check
pain: Unsure whether everything is ready before the first customer.
outcome: Readiness is derived from the real state, with one next step.
hook: „Du weißt immer, was vor dem Start noch fehlt.“
qualifier: Live today: a short setup list for new accounts.

name: Das Schild am Tresen
pain: Software alone is invisible in the shop.
outcome: A printable counter sign turns the counter into the entry point.
hook: „Der Tresen wird zum Eingang in die Kundenbeziehung.“
qualifier: The merchant prints the sign; Loynara does not ship stands (FUT-16).

name: Barber: jeder Schnitt zählt
pain: Visit rhythm and word of mouth carry the business.
outcome: Card per cut, referral bonus after a confirmed first visit, last visit per card.
hook: „Jeder Schnitt zählt. Auch für den nächsten Termin.“
qualifier: The rhythm view exists per card only (RET-01).

name: Pizzeria: aus einer Bestellung die nächste
pain: Weekly regulars order elsewhere without anyone noticing.
outcome: The familiar tenth-pizza card on the phone, with several stamps in one step for big orders.
hook: „Die zehnte Pizza kennt jeder. Jetzt ohne Pappkarte.“
proof: Pizzeria page example; several stamps in one step
qualifier: Orders through delivery platforms are not counted; there is no POS integration.

name: Pizzeria: keine Provision
pain: Platform fees per order.
outcome: A flat €39 per location, with no fee per order.
hook: „Keine Provision pro Bestellung.“
qualifier: Always say: platform orders do not run through Loynara.

name: Café/Bäckerei: Laufkundschaft wird Stammgast
pain: High frequency, small baskets, paper cards in every wallet.
outcome: The tenth coffee on the phone; staff scan while the machine runs.
hook: „Aus Laufkundschaft können Stammgäste werden.“
qualifier: No speed claim until scan time has been measured at pilots.

name: Salon/Beauty: Termine werden Beziehung
pain: Long gaps between appointments; clients drift to competitors.
outcome: A card across appointments, with referrals.
hook: „Mach aus einzelnen Terminen eine langfristige Kundenbeziehung.“
qualifier: The browser card shows the shop name and colour, not a logo. Packages are FUTURE (FUT-19).

name: Autopflege: lange Intervalle
pain: Customers come every few months.
outcome: A stamp card that also works across long intervals.
hook: „Ein Kunde kommt nicht jede Woche. Gerade deshalb zählt jeder Besuch.“
qualifier: Deferred vertical (low frequency). Due-date reminders are FUTURE.

name: Fitness: Regelmäßigkeit belohnen
pain: Members drop off.
outcome: Attendance progress.
hook: „Belohne Regelmäßigkeit, bevor die Motivation weg ist.“
qualifier: Deferred vertical: membership and check-in models differ, and reactivation is FUTURE.

name: Restaurant: Gäste kommen regelmäßig wieder
pain: Guests come once.
outcome: A reward for coming back.
hook: „Gib Gästen einen Grund, regelmäßig wiederzukommen.“
qualifier: Deferred vertical: table service weakens the counter moment, and off-peak offers are FUTURE.

name: „Meine Stammkunden kommen sowieso“
pain: The owner sees no problem.
outcome: Reward exactly that behaviour and see how many there are.
hook: „Gut – dann belohn genau das und sieh, wie viele es sind.“

name: „Ich hab doch Instagram“
pain: Social media feels like enough.
outcome: Instagram brings people in; Loynara is about what happens after the first purchase.
hook: „Instagram bringt Leute rein. Loynara kümmert sich darum, was nach dem ersten Kauf passiert.“

name: „Meine Kunden sind älter“
pain: Fear of excluding loyal customers.
outcome: No app needed; anyone without a smartphone keeps the paper card.
hook: „Keine App nötig – und wer kein Smartphone hat, behält einfach die Papierkarte.“
proof: The owner scans the demo themselves

name: „Ich weiß nicht, ob das funktioniert“
pain: No proof yet.
outcome: A review of the shop's own numbers after three weeks.
hook: „Nach drei Wochen schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine Zahlen.“
qualifier: Never cite other merchants' results until 13-learning-system allows it.

name: Verschwundene Stammkunden zurückholen
pain: A regular stops coming.
outcome: Merchant-approved win-back message to dormant regulars.
hook: „Sieh, wer früher regelmäßig kam – und heute fehlt.“
qualifier: Blocked by: production email off; audiences/automations withheld in production

name: Persönlicher Besuchsrhythmus
pain: A customer breaks their usual cadence.
outcome: Detect cadence breaks per customer.
hook: „Sonst alle drei Wochen – jetzt sieben.“
qualifier: Blocked by: not built (advanced analytics)

name: Kurz vor der Prämie / Prämie wartet
pain: Customers one visit from a reward, or with an unredeemed reward, forget it.
outcome: Near-reward and reward-waiting reminders.
hook: „Noch ein Besuch bis zur Prämie.“
qualifier: Blocked by: audience withheld in production; email off

name: Willkommensstrecke
pain: The first visit leaves no trace.
outcome: A welcome step after the first visit.
hook: „Der erste Besuch ist der Anfang.“
qualifier: Blocked by: automations withheld; email off

name: Geburtstag und Anlässe
pain: No occasion to celebrate with the customer.
outcome: Occasion rewards with permission.
hook: „Ein Grund zum Feiern – bei dir.“
qualifier: Blocked by: no birthday data collected; needs data-protection basis

name: Eigene Zielgruppe statt Algorithmus
pain: Reach depends on social algorithms.
outcome: Permission-based direct contact with existing customers.
hook: „Deine nächste Aktion startet mit Leuten, die schon bei dir gekauft haben.“
qualifier: Blocked by: marketing contact + sending not enabled in production

name: Richtiges Angebot an die Richtigen
pain: Every offer goes to everybody.
outcome: Segmented, relevant offers.
hook: „Nicht jedes Angebot passt zu jedem Kunden.“
qualifier: Blocked by: campaigns/audiences withheld in production

name: Ruhige Zeiten nutzen
pain: Tuesday 15:30: staff there, tables empty; fixed costs run.
outcome: Merchant-approved action for weak periods to eligible regulars.
hook: „Dienstag. 15:30. Der Laden ist leer.“
verticals: Café, restaurant, takeaway, beauty, car wash
qualifier: Blocked by: campaigns withheld; email off; day/time analytics not built (quiet-hours send policy is RC READY)

name: Muster nach Tag und Uhrzeit
pain: Unclear when loyalty activity is strong or weak.
outcome: Day/time pattern view.
hook: „Wann ist bei dir wirklich wenig los?“
qualifier: Blocked by: not in live analytics

name: Was nach einer Aktion passierte
pain: Sends without outcome.
outcome: Post-action outcome view without causation claims.
hook: „Nicht beim Versenden aufhören.“
qualifier: Blocked by: campaigns not enabled

name: Woher Kunden kommen
pain: Unknown whether customers came from counter, referral, QR or campaign.
outcome: Acquisition source per card.
hook: „Woher kam dein neuer Kunde?“
qualifier: Blocked by: not shown in production (referral status per card is QUALIFIED via ACQ-02)

name: Sehen → Verstehen → Handeln
pain: A dashboard only reports.
outcome: Observation paired with the next supported action.
hook: „Nicht nur sehen. Handeln.“
qualifier: Blocked by: action paths (campaigns) withheld; rule-based hints live via TRU-10

name: Branchenwissen
pain: A barbershop gets café assumptions.
outcome: Industry-aware setup and hints.
hook: „Ein Barbershop ist kein Café.“
qualifier: Blocked by: not built

name: Wallet-Karte
pain: Customers want the card where their tickets are.
outcome: Apple/Google Wallet pass with merchant brand.
hook: „Karte im Wallet, immer griffbereit.“
qualifier: Blocked by: Wallet provider-blocked; previews withheld in production

name: Logo auf der Karte
pain: Brand only as colour.
outcome: Merchant logo on the browser card.
hook: „Dein Logo auf jeder Karte.“
qualifier: Blocked by: logo display withheld in production

name: Premium-Aufsteller
pain: A printed sheet looks cheap.
outcome: A professional physical stand, location-specific.
hook: „Ein Aufsteller, der zu deinem Laden passt.“
qualifier: Blocked by: hardware not offered; commercial terms open

name: Prämienkatalog
pain: One reward does not fit everyone.
outcome: Customers choose what they work toward.
hook: „Deine Kunden wählen ihre Prämie.“
qualifier: Blocked by: not built (one reward per programme)

name: Stufen und Status
pain: Best customers are treated like everyone else.
outcome: Tiers worth keeping.
hook: „Für deine besten Kunden.“
qualifier: Blocked by: not built

name: Pakete und Vorauszahlung
pain: Repeat visits are not sold upfront.
outcome: Prepaid packages.
hook: „Zehn Termine im Paket.“
qualifier: Blocked by: not built; financial/legal complexity

name: Standorte vergleichen
pain: Several shops, no comparison.
outcome: Activity compared by location.
hook: „Welcher Laden läuft besser?“
qualifier: Blocked by: not verified in live analytics

name: Bewertung nach einem guten Moment
pain: Happy customers rarely leave reviews.
outcome: A neutral review request after a positive moment; never incentivised.
hook: „Zufrieden? Erzähl es weiter.“
qualifier: Blocked by: not built; platform rules and UWG forbid incentivised reviews — keep neutral
